name: Castello dell'Acqua (Italy)
description: White field with a blue border, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Castello dell'Acqua (a castle above water) within branches and the inscription COMUNE DI CASTELLO DELL'ACQUA in grey above.
history: Municipal flag of Castello dell'Acqua, a comune in Lombardy; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Castello dell'Acqua arms — castle above water, crowned, within branches
inscription COMUNE DI CASTELLO DELL'ACQUA above the arms
